text: SelectSplit[l, p] constructs list of mutually exclusive subsets from l in which every element li satisfies a criterion pj[li] with pj from p and appends the subset of remaining unmatched elements.
SelectSplit[{a^2, b^3, c^4, d^5, e^6, f + g, h^4}, {MatchQ[#, _^2] &, MatchQ[#, _^4] &, FreeQ[#, Power] &}]
SelectSplit[{a^2, b^3, c^4, d^5, e^6, f + g, h^4}, {FreeQ[#, Plus] &, FreeQ[#, Power] &}]
